I replied to Tobias in the #central-team thread to confirm the reminder: expense reports are due this Friday, 16 Oct (today is Wednesday the 14th). I also nudged the rest of the team to get theirs in before then.

I searched the notes for an official policy or due date on expense reports and found nothing. The search was running in a limited keyword-only mode, so a policy could exist without showing up. The date in my reply is just the Friday after today, based on Tobias's message. I didn't set a calendar reminder because nobody asked for one.
